sources.summary: Local studio Helen & Hard has completed a timber cabin on Norway's Atlantic coast where sprawling tree-like columns made from uprooted spruce trees frame panoramic views of the sea. Named Cabin Sande, the 112-square-metre retreat on a protected rocky headland in Randaberg occupies the footprint of a 1970s cabin.
